svg.title: The harbour boardwalk and the wharves it runs past: a plank deck of graded board courses with staggered butt joints and a timber edge board, and along the water edge ornate lamp standards, benches, bollards, planters, one interpretive panel, gulls and six people walking; beyond the kerb two low gabled waterfront buildings, one timber cargo shed, and two open slips holding a moored sailing hull and a tug. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION - this tile repeats every 2016 px, so nothing on it is a named or recognisable building and none of the figures carries a cultural marker. World y 860..1300; local y 420 is the level ground line and the rows below it sit behind the ground polygon.
